title: Yere oturmak

characters.MOM: a young mother of about thirty with long wavy black hair in a loose ponytail, wearing a lavender sweater
characters.KID: her son, a boy of about five with curly brown hair, wearing a yellow sweater
characters.GROWN: the same boy grown up, a man of about thirty with curly brown hair, wearing a yellow sweater
characters.LITTLEGIRL: his little daughter, a girl of about three with curly brown hair, wearing a pink dress
characters.GRANDMA: the same mother, now in her sixties with grey wavy hair in a loose ponytail, wearing a lavender sweater

scenes.text:
Çocuğun, aldığın oyuncakları değil,
yere oturduğun günleri hatırlayacak.
scenes.prompt: In a cozy living room in the evening, {MOM} looks tired but sits down cross-legged on a soft rug next to {KID}, who smiles up at her, wooden toy blocks scattered on the rug, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Yorgun bir akşam halıda
birlikte kurduğunuz o eğri kuleyi.
scenes.prompt: {MOM} and {KID} sit on the rug looking proudly at a tall crooked tower of wooden blocks between them, both laughing, warm lamp light, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Yağmurda su birikintisine
seninle beraber atladığı günü.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy autumn street, {MOM} and {KID}, both in raincoats and rubber boots, jump together into a big puddle, laughing, water splashing, golden leaves falling.

scenes.text:
Bir gün o da yere oturacak,
kendi çocuğunun yanına.
scenes.prompt: Years later, {GROWN} sits cross-legged on a rug next to {LITTLEGIRL}, both looking at a crooked tower of wooden blocks between them, warm lamp light, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Miras, halıda geçen o akşamlardır.
Bunu yorgun bir anneye gönder.
scenes.prompt: {GRANDMA} stands in a warm doorway smiling with teary eyes, looking toward a living room rug where a crooked tower of wooden blocks stands, lamp light, autumn leaves falling outside the window.

caption:
Çocuğun seni nasıl hatırlayacak?

Oyuncaklar unutulur, halıda geçen akşamlar unutulmaz. 🤍

Bunu yorgun bir anneye gönder.
